email_subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoCardolol patient with a mild headache

[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a treating physician at Demo Regional Hospital (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 20-year-old male patient with a history of hypertension received their second dose of DemoCardolol (dose: 50mg).
Approximately 2 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed a mild headache.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
R. Okafor (fictional reporter)
Demo Regional Hospital
